title: C25 ORION BURST SENTINEL engineering data contract
description: Proposed record contract. No data have been collected by this generator. Null is missing/unknown and must be qualified in the separate provenance record.

noise_interval.x-encoding: Structured JSON record; member names, frames and mandatory subfields must be frozen in the project ICD before ingestion.

items.x-encoding: real and imag share the declared physical unit; covariance ordering and any complex pseudo-covariance are recorded in the sidecar.

whitened_tiles.x-quality-rule: PSD/window conventions and gap masks required.

trial_response.x-quality-rule: Condition number and network rank recorded.

injection_truth.x-encoding: Structured JSON record; member names, frames and mandatory subfields must be frozen in the project ICD before ingestion.
injection_truth.description: Waveform, sky, orientation and event time.

efficiency.x-encoding: Structured JSON record; member names, frames and mandatory subfields must be frozen in the project ICD before ingestion.

trigger_window.x-encoding: Structured JSON record; member names, frames and mandatory subfields must be frozen in the project ICD before ingestion.
trigger_window.x-quality-rule: Null gives untriggered search; association provenance mandatory.

x-unit-policy: Use documented units; do not replace missing values with zero. Reference frames, covariance basis, calibration version and quality qualifiers reside in the provenance sidecar.
x-domain-validation: Physical range, covariance validity and declared quality rules require domain validation beyond JSON Schema.
